title: Inside ITER: the machine and fusion gain
description: Explore ITER's magnets, vacuum vessel, blanket, divertor and heating, calculate the fusion gain Q, and see why ITER's planned Q = 10 is a plasma gain, not electricity or a commercial power plant.

sources.title: ITER Organization: What will ITER do? (Q = 10, 500 MW from 50 MW, burning plasma, test blanket modules, no electricity, licence 2012)
ITER Organization: Facts and figures (plasma volume 830 m³, 400–600 s pulses, 150 million °C, JET Q = 0.67)
ITER Organization: Magnets (18 TF coils, 11.8 T; 6 PF coils; central solenoid 13 m, 6 modules)
sources.note: The component data of the explorer (units/fy14/data/iter.json) give every part's sources; checked 2026-11-01.

sources.title: ITER Organization: Divertor (54 cassettes, tungsten, 10–20 MW/m²)
ITER Organization: Tritium Plant Summit (closed fuel loop, burn fraction about 1 %, detritiation)
ITER Organization: Tokamak Building (the concrete bioshield)
ITER (Wikipedia): plant draws over 300 MW of electricity; 15 MA plasma current; ITER produces no electricity
